_about: Fictional episode: Owen Testcase, lower back pain after lifting at work. N-001 Sarah Reid (initial assessment), N-002 Tom Ellis (discharge). Cases add or replace notes with `notes`. tenantId is set by the harness.

source.label: Simulated TM3 sandbox – demo data, not affiliated with TM3

referral.name: Example Freight Ltd (fictional)
referral.reason: Back pain after a lifting incident at work on 12/03/2026.

incident.mechanism: Lifted a 20 kg parcel with a twist.

notes.author: sarah
notes.subjective: Lifting injury at work on 12/03/2026. Central LBP, NPRS 7/10 at worst. Sitting tolerance 20 min. Off work since 13/03/2026.
notes.objective: Lumbar flexion 50% limited. TTP L4/5 paraspinals. SLR 70° R. ODI 48%.
notes.assessment: Presentation consistent with acute mechanical low back pain. No red flags.
notes.plan: HEP: pelvic tilts 10 x 3/day. Review in about 6–7 wks.

notes.author: tom
notes.subjective: LBP 2/10 at worst after shifts. Working amended duties.
notes.objective: Lumbar AROM full and pain-free. ODI 18%.
notes.assessment: Opinion on work: in my opinion he is fit for a phased return to normal duties over 2 weeks; he should avoid repetitive lifting >15 kg for 4 weeks.
